items.title: Howard Alden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: He was born in 1958 in Newport Beach, California, and took guitar lessons from George Van Eps.

ctx.x: Right. I read a little quote that you had said, I think it’s you, about practicing. And if you don’t practice for one day, that you notice it? How did that go?

Oh, right. I was paraphrasing someone else. I think it dates back to one of the great classical musicians or something. I heard it from George Van Eps, via George Van Eps. Yeah, if I don’t practice for one day I notice it; if I don’t practice for two days, the conductor notices it; and if I don’t practice it for three days everybody notices.
Yeah. What’s your practice — if you sit to practice, what do you practice these days?
